correctness.rationale: Read complete assigned RESULT.md at frozen Git blob dc2340907504e4dddf6fbd5a53c31dabdd9fa913 and inspect verification source. Facet-length vectors satisfy sum ell_j=P, sum ell_j*u_j=0. For odd N absence of antipodal pairs prevents lower-dimensional limit; Minkowski existence identifies the feasible compact polytope with polygons up to translation. Additivity of planar surface area measures and Brunn–Minkowski concavity of sqrt(area) force area minimum at a vertex with exactly three positive facet lengths; strict BM equality rules out distinct mixtures attaining it. Normal-gap integers k_i<N/2 and sum N correspond to positive odd triangle-angle integers a_i=N-2k_i, sum N. For a triangle area=P^2/[4 sum cot(pi*a_i/(2N))]; strict convexity of cot gives the unique multiset (1,1,N-2), yielding isosceles equality. Classical polygonal isoperimetric inequality yields maximum regular N-gon; even grids allow two antipodal pairs flattening to zero; interpolation gives interval. Independent geometric min/equality calculations for odd N=3..37 match the formula. Small N=3 yields the same equilateral geometry under N grid rotations, not N distinguishable polygons. No arbitrary normal sets or strictly-positive-all-facets interpretation is claimed.
